title: Draft: dfilter: Generalize function argument types
description:
Do not restrict function arguments to a particular type, like
a field. Allow any entity as function argument. Even if
using a function on a constant for example is not a common
use-case it need not be a syntactical error either and it is
doubtful that that is desirable. Any semantic errors are
still checked and reported.
